facts.en: Earned a Bachelor of Science in applied statistics at Fictional Amberbay University in 2017.
facts.zh: 2017 年在虚构琥珀湾大学获得应用统计学理学学士学位。

facts.en: Paid reservations reporting assistant at Fictional Reedharbour Hotels from 2017-10 to 2021-01.
facts.zh: 2017-10 至 2021-01 在虚构芦港酒店公司任有薪预订报表助理。

facts.en: Paid revenue data analyst at Fictional Larchwindow Hospitality from 2021-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-02 至 2026-08 在虚构落叶松窗酒店集团任有薪收益数据分析员。

facts.en: Combines booking-system exports with approved room-inventory calendars for weekly reporting.
facts.zh: 将预订系统导出数据与获批客房库存日历结合，用于每周报表。

facts.en: Builds SQL extracts for booking status and compares changes by arrival date and rate category.
facts.zh: 建立预订状态 SQL 提取，并按抵达日期及房价类别比较变化。

facts.en: Flags cancelled bookings, complimentary stays and rooms unavailable for sale in separate report categories.
facts.zh: 在独立报表类别中标记取消预订、免费住宿及不可售客房。

facts.en: The revenue manager approves price changes and inventory restrictions; the candidate supplies analysis.
facts.zh: 收益经理批准价格变更及库存限制；候选人提供分析。

facts.en: Built the validation workbook for a 2025-08 reporting refresh covering 4 fictional hotels.
facts.zh: 为覆盖 4 家虚构酒店的 2025-08 报表更新建立验证工作簿。

facts.en: Personally wrote booking-status checks and reconciled exceptions with property teams; a data engineer maintained the scheduled feeds.
facts.zh: 个人编写预订状态检查，并与酒店团队核对异常；数据工程师维护定时数据源。

facts.en: A draft weekly summary lists 1260 available room-nights and 945 sold room-nights for one property.
facts.zh: 一份周度摘要草稿列出一家酒店 1260 个可售间夜及 945 个已售间夜。

facts.en: A note says the inventory extract may include rooms under refurbishment; the final confirmed denominator of available room-nights was not supplied.
facts.zh: 一则备注称库存导出数据可能包含翻修中的客房；未提供最终确认的可售间夜数分母。

facts.en: The supplied draft contains no confirmed occupancy percentage or verified revenue uplift.
facts.zh: 所供草稿不含经确认的入住率或经核实的收益提升。

facts.en: Uses SQL, spreadsheet scenario tables and dashboard filters for historical reporting.
facts.zh: 使用 SQL、电子表格情景表及仪表板筛选进行历史报表分析。

facts.en: Presents descriptive booking trends and explains known data exclusions at weekly revenue meetings.
facts.zh: 在每周收益会议展示描述性预订趋势，并解释已知数据排除项。

facts.en: Completed internal booking-data governance training in 2022-05.
facts.zh: 2022-05 完成内部预订数据治理培训。

facts.en: Documents report changes and keeps draft analyses distinct from manager-approved trading decisions.
facts.zh: 记录报表变更，并将分析草稿与经理批准的经营决定分开。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Mintquay Film Club, maintaining a noncommercial seat-reservation list.
facts.zh: 在虚构薄荷码头电影社做志愿者，维护非商业座位预约清单。

facts.en: Created a personal board-game score dashboard in 2024 using invented match data.
facts.zh: 2024 年使用虚构对局数据制作个人桌游积分仪表板。

facts.en: That dashboard was not connected to hotel bookings or used to set commercial room prices.
facts.zh: 该仪表板未连接酒店预订，亦未用于设定商业房价。

facts.en: Enjoys designing fictional travel postcards and playing strategy card games.
facts.zh: 爱好设计虚构旅行明信片及玩策略卡牌游戏。

facts.en: Maintains a follow-up list for missing property extracts and unresolved booking-status discrepancies.
facts.zh: 维护后续跟进清单，记录缺失酒店导出数据及未解决预订状态差异。
